title: Out-of-order pause/resume at_ms passes parse validation; paused_at resolves by slice order and ticks_stepped_by u64-wraps
detail: A demo with `at 70000ms pause` before `at 60500ms resume` alternates correctly, so parse accepts it. paused_at then returns the resume's state at every tick (run never pauses, silently), and with re < pe the subtraction hi-pe+1 wraps u64, mis-lowering command apply_ticks.
recommended_fix: At parse time, reject any pause/resume whose at_ms is less than the previous pause event's at_ms (fail loud, like the alternation check), or sort d.pauses by at_ms after parsing.
